description: A Fragment subclass implementing a home UI for an Android TV app using Leanback library. It includes top navigation, background handling, content rows with cards, and manages lifecycle-safe UI setup.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Main fragment managing the TV home screen, including background, header, and row content.

classes.name: CardItem
classes.description: Data class representing individual media cards with id, title, description, and image resource.

classes.name: HeroCardPresenter
classes.description: Presenter for rendering media card views with focus scaling and title overlays.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initial setup, preparing background and setting click and select listeners.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Handles view creation, caches root view, and sets up UI components safely.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Cleans up view references to prevent leaks.

methods.name: prepareBackground
methods.description: Initializes and configures the background manager with a placeholder banner.

methods.name: setupUIAndTitleSafely
methods.description: Configures UI and title properties after the view hierarchy is created, with lifecycle safety.

methods.name: buildTopNavBarIfReady
methods.description: Creates the top navigation bar after confirming title view is ready.

methods.name: setTitlePaddingForTV
methods.description: Adjusts padding and typography for TV layout, considering overscan safety.

methods.name: buildRows
methods.description: Constructs the content rows for the home screen.

methods.name: buildCardRow
methods.description: Builds an individual row of media cards with a header.

methods.name: sampleItems
methods.description: Generates sample media card items from given titles.

methods.name: onItemClicked
methods.description: Handles media item click events (placeholder implementation).

methods.name: onItemSelected
methods.description: Updates background banner when a media item is selected.
